description.html: HabiStat Tortoise Food Fruit & Flower is a high-fiber, low-protein, calcium-rich pellet food for tortoises. Composition: oats, maize, oat bran, lucerne, beet pulp, calcium carbonate, dicalcium phosphate, turmeric and spirulina, with banana and freshly mown grass aromas. Vitamins A, D3 and E are added, along with iron, copper, zinc, manganese, iodine and selenium. The large jar is practical if you feed several tortoises or use this food regularly. A smaller jar is also available.

This is a complementary food, not a replacement for fresh greens. The manufacturer recommends feeding it a couple of times a week as part of a varied diet, at 1-4% of the tortoise's body weight. Soak the pellets in warm water before feeding to soften them. Store in a cool, dark place.
It suits European, Russian and most other tortoise species. Learn how to set up a home for your tortoise in our tortoise terrarium guide.

Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Fast courier delivery. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order directly at our workshop. Contact us with any questions about the product or for a recommendation for your species.
